newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan steel shares mixed after forecast revisions.
newsitem.headline: Japan steel shares mixed after forecast revisions.

text.p: Shares of Japanese steel makers were mixed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on early Friday morning after major steel companies on Thursday announced their earnings revisions for the year to March 31, 1997.
By 0023 GMT, Kawasaki Steel Corp was up five yen at 317, while Sumitomo Metal Industries Ltd was down three yen at 274 by 0019 GMT.

All of Japan's top five steelmakers, except for Kobe Steel Ltd, said in their earnings revisions announcements on Thursday that their profits for this fiscal year to March 31 would be higher than actual 1995/96 profits.
By 0019 GMT, Kobe Steel was down one yen to 218 yen.
By 0027 GMT, Nippon Steel Corp was up one yen at 323 and NKK Corp was also up one yen at 248.
